notes.title: Twin Stick Tennis development update [Jan 2024]
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear aspiring ball smackers, [/h1]

The development of Twin Stick Tennis is entering it final state. The release date will be annouched soon. Below a list of recent updates made to the game. First the big updates followed by a series of smaller updates. 

[h2]You can now play Padel matches![/h2]
This is a new game mode that uses the rules of Padel. Use walls to bounce balls around to outplay your opponent. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800016/4eac42ddfec14214e9aa7d3b0a0693f459fb8bcb.gif[/img]

[h2]You can now Slide[/h2]
This was one of the most requested features. Sliding will give you a short speed boost during which you cannot steer the player. Slides can be activated with: <Right Shoulder Button>, <Pressing Right Stick>, <Space Bar> or <Numpad 0>. Happy sliding!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800016/6179174025524ec84f7a79cb07e36b932de49415.gif[/img]

[h2]Custom field designer[/h2]
There will be a mode in which you can adjust court dimensions to customize your ball smacking experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800016/f9f249cfe3e701ae02f4f5eaf7ba485f698f7596.gif[/img]

[h2]Disable typical tennis rules:[/h2]
It is now possible to disable the enforcing of the following tennis rules:
[list]
[*] Double hits
[*] Wall hits
[*] Volley on serve
[*] Hits on wrong side of net
[*] Player hits
[/list]
Disabling rules makes the game more arcade like, making it less punishing for new players and allowing for new strategies to outplay your opponent.  

[h2]Other updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overhaul of the Twin Stick Tennis look on steam
[*] Added an unlock system 
[*] More balls
[*] More rackets, and various sizes of rackets
[*] You can now celebrate by shooting particles from the tip of your racket
[*] Added cloud saves
[*] Added Steam stats
[*] Added Steam achievements
[*] Added Steam Remote play 
[*] Controller support is improved with better glyps
[*] There is an audience now and they will be clapping if you impress them
[*] Visuals for sets won is improved
[*] Adjusting the scoring system is more flexible. 
[/list]
